remarks: Located on the Belle Haven peninsula is this beautiful 6-bedroom showhouse with brand new interiors & pool. Set on a private cul-de-sac, this period home has just been redone for today's lifestyle. There are classic details, high ceilings & spacious rooms. First floor offers gourmet eat-in kitchen with stainless steel appliances, dining area, large pantry, family room, dining room, living room with access to sunroom & patio. The second floor has a primary suite with walk-in closet & luxe bath plus three additional bedrooms & two baths. Third floor has seasonal views of L.I. Sound, 2 bedrooms/offices & bath. Lower level has playroom/game room, half bath, space for gym, workshop & storage. Bonus: large yard, pool, 6 garages & generator. Greenwich Avenue, w/restaurants, shops & train nearby.
